scenarios.task: As Sophia Silva (user id sophia_silva_7557), you want to review your future reservations and cancel every reservation that contains any single flight longer than 4 hours. Ask the agent to tell you each flight's duration so you can decide. For reservations you keep, you may also request cabin upgrades (e.g., to business) on specific reservations. Authorize any charges to your credit card on file. Confirm which reservations were cancelled or modified and the resulting costs.

Her payment method on file is credit_card_4196779. Flight durations must be computed from each flight's scheduled departure and arrival times; some flights (e.g., transcontinental LAX-EWR and EWR-LAX legs at ~5.5 hours) exceed 4 hours while others do not. Basic economy reservations cannot normally be modified except for cabin upgrades under certain conditions per airline policy.

checklist: Agent correctly identifies which reservations contain at least one flight longer than 4 hours and communicates each relevant flight's duration to the user
Reservations containing a flight over 4 hours are cancelled (only if the reservation qualifies for cancellation under policy), and those with no such flight are not cancelled
Any cabin upgrade or modification is applied only to a reservation the user chose to keep, using payment_id credit_card_4196779, with the price difference stated
No changes are made without the user's explicit confirmation of that specific action
A clear final summary lists each reservation's outcome (cancelled, upgraded, or unchanged) and associated charges/refunds

clusters.name: Flight reservation management
clusters.description: These tasks involve booking, canceling, or modifying airline flight reservations, including changing cabins, passengers, dates, or routes.

clusters.name: Product exchange requests
clusters.description: These tasks involve exchanging or returning delivered items for different variants based on specified attribute preferences like size, switch type, brightness, or power source.

clusters.name: Pending order modifications
clusters.description: These tasks involve updating pending orders and account details, such as changing shipping addresses, swapping product variants, or canceling items before shipment.

clusters.name: Airline reservation management
clusters.description: These tasks involve managing airline flight reservations, including cancellations, changes, baggage inquiries, and seeking compensation for delays.

clusters.name: Order Returns and Cancellations
clusters.description: These tasks involve returning or canceling items or orders and processing refunds to specified or original payment methods.

clusters.name: One-way flight cancellations
clusters.description: These tasks involve canceling a one-way flight reservation and seeking a refund, often citing specific personal circumstances.

clusters.name: Flight Reservation Modifications
clusters.description: These tasks involve booking or modifying airline reservations by changing details such as passengers, class, baggage, and insurance.

clusters.name: Order tracking and returns
clusters.description: These tasks involve retrieving order tracking numbers and processing returns, refunds, or exchanges for shipped items.

clusters.name: Order modification and returns
clusters.description: These tasks involve managing existing customer orders through cancellations, returns, exchanges, or reinstatements.

clusters.name: Wireless Earbud Variant Exchange
clusters.description: These tasks involve exchanging delivered wireless earbuds for a different variant with different attributes such as water resistance.
